# Raw partition (NOT a filesystem) for cat_log.c's persistent CAT-traffic
# ring buffer — see that file for the full design. Deliberately sized far
# larger than the ~40KB of "live" data 1000 fixed-size records actually
# need: sequential-append-then-wrap across many more sectors than the live
# data requires spreads flash erase/write wear thin (each individual 4KB
# sector is only reclaimed once every ~13
# instead of every ~100 lines a naive same-sector ring buffer would cause)
# — see the flash-endurance research this size was chosen from. Custom
# subtype 0x40 is inside the 0x40-0xFE "user-defined" range reserved for
# non-standard data partitions
catlog
